The Role: 
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager who will own the vision, roadmap, and execution across Zūm’s core platform. This is a highly strategic role for someone who thinks like a builder, balancing the near term with the long term vision. A successful PM in the role would be comfortable combining product sense, customer empathy, and platform & systems thinking. Your work will directly impact operational efficiency, customer satisfaction & retention, and sales enablement. You will work with a talented team of product leaders, designers, and engineers to innovate and enhance Zūm’s transportation platform across multiple mobile and web touch points.
 
Key Competencies: 
• Strong in platform and systems thinking; capable of creating modular building blocks that scale across districts, geographies, and use cases.
• Experienced with SaaS product development, ideally with configurable enterprise workflows.
• Technically fluent to navigate APIs, integrations, sensor/GPS data, routing logic, or mobile workflows.
• Scrappy, resourceful, and resilient; comfortable solving problems without waiting for perfect inputs.
• A “roll-up-your-sleeves” builder with a bias for action who loves digging into constraints, edge cases, operational nuance, and real-world workflows.
• Great at introducing lightweight processes to help a scaling org move faster, not slower.
• Someone who takes full ownership of outcomes and is nimble: value delivered, operational performance, customer delight, business impact.
• Comfortable working across a uniquely complex stakeholder universe: engineering, design, sales, routers, drivers, dispatch, payroll, finance, districts, and more.
 
Experience: 
• 5+ years of product management experience, including owning a core product area end-to-end.
• Experience shipping SaaS products for enterprise or operational users.
• Comfort working in fast-moving, ambiguous, and constraint-heavy environments.
• Passion for mission-driven work and designing systems with real-world impact at scale. 
• A demonstrated track record of shipping high-impact customer-facing features.
• Experience in mobility, logistics, fleets, marketplaces, or operationally complex products is a strong plus.

description:
About Zūm:

Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (Zūm CMX™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – Zūm CMX  is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 7,500 schools rely on Zūm CMX. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.

Who You Are:

You are a sharp, articulate product marketer who knows how to turn a complex product into a story that resonates with buyers. As Zūm’s Senior Product Marketing Manager, you are an individual contributor who operates with the focus and output of someone who loves the craft—researching buyers, developing product positioning, arming sellers, and bringing new capabilities to market with intention and precision. You are someone who hits the ground running, doesn’t need a lot of hand-holding, and takes pride in the quality of everything that leaves your desk.

This is a hybrid position based out of our headquarters in Redwood City, CA. You will be required to be onsite 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). We will only consider candidates already based in the Bay Area. 

What You’ll Do:

Develop & Define Product Positioning and Messaging

  • Research, develop, and define differentiated positioning and messaging for Zūm’s individual products—translating capabilities into buyer-facing narratives that are clear, credible, and compelling.
  • Translate product capabilities into language that resonates with each persona, from district transportation directors to operations leaders to procurement teams. You make technical features feel like obvious answers to real problems.
  • Build and maintain messaging frameworks for individual products that serve as the source of truth for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success
  • Conduct win/loss analysis and ongoing buyer research to pressure-test messaging and surface the insights that sharpen how we go to market.

Lead Go-to-Market Launches

  • Own go-to-market planning and execution for new product releases and feature launches, from messaging development and sales enablement to campaign briefs and launch communications.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Product, Sales, CS, and Demand Gen to ensure launches land with clarity and impact, internally and externally.
  • Define launch tiers, build timelines, and keep stakeholders on track, so nothing ships without a plan and nothing important goes unannounced.
  • Write launch content: release notes, blog posts, customer emails, sales alerts, and website copy updates.

Enable the Sales Team

  • Build and maintain a sales enablement library that sellers actually use: battlecards, objection handling guides, pitch decks, one-pagers, and ROI frameworks tailored to real buyer conversations.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to understand where deals stall, and develop targeted assets that close the gap.
  • Run enablement sessions that are sharp and practical
  • Track what’s working and iterate based on direct feedback from the field.

Develop Content & Thought Leadership

  • Partner with content and demand gen to brief, shape, and review marketing content, ensuring everything published reflects accurate, on-message product positioning.
  • Contribute to high-value content including solution briefs, white papers, case study narratives, and website copy that advances how we tell our product story.
  • Help establish Zūm’s voice in the market through thought leadership that earns attention and builds credibility with the buyers we care about most.

Contribute to Competitive Intelligence

  • Monitor the competitive landscape continuously—tracking positioning shifts, new entrants, and market developments that affect how we sell and how we win.
  • Produce crisp, actionable competitive briefs and battlecards that give Sales the confidence to navigate difficult conversations.
  • Bring competitive insights into product and marketing conversations, ensuring Zūm stays ahead of the narrative.

What You Bring To Zūm:

  • 5+ years of B2B product marketing experience at a SaaS or technology company. You’ve developed positioning, led launches, and built enablement materials.
  • Exceptional writing skills. You can craft a positioning statement, a punchy one-pager, and a tight executive narrative.
  • A solid foundation in positioning methodology: you’ve built messaging frameworks from scratch, stress-tested them with sales teams, and used win/loss data to iterate.
  • Hands-on experience developing sales enablement materials that field teams actually use and that move conversion rates.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts—you build real relationships with Product, Sales, and CS, and you can hold your own in a roadmap review or a deal debrief.
  • Highly self-directed. As an individual contributor, you own your work end-to-end.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for action. You don’t need a perfect brief to get started; you define the problem and build toward the answer.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience marketing to public sector, education, or government buyers.
  • Familiarity with sales enablement platforms like Highspot or Seismic.
  • Experience at a high-growth startup where you had to build programs from scratch with limited resources and high expectations.
  • Background in category creation or narrative-led marketing at a company defining a new space.

The targeted base salary range for this role is listed in the compensation section below. Actual salary may be above or below this range based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. In addition, this position may include additional compensation in the form of equity or commissions. If you are a full-time salaried or hourly worker, we offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Holidays, Wellness, Vacation, and more. The targeted pay range for this role in US CA is: $175,000 - $195,000

Zūm is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Operations Excellence to drive process improvement, standardization, and performance management across our transportation network. This role focuses on building scalable processes and KPI frameworks across fleet operations, safety, compliance, and maintenance to improve efficiency, reliability, and cost performance.

This role is ideal for candidates with backgrounds in consulting, strategic finance, logistics, or manufacturing, who bring strong analytical rigor and the ability to translate complex operational challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions.

You will partner closely with Operations, Fleet, Safety, Finance, Product, and field teams to ensure consistent execution and measurable impact across locations.

This is a hybrid position based out of our headquarters in Redwood City, CA. You will be required to be onsite 3 days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). We will only consider candidates already located in the Bay Area.

Process Improvement & Standardization

  • Identify inefficiencies and design scalable SOPs across fleet, safety, compliance, and maintenance workflows
  • Simplify and modernize manual or inconsistent processes (e.g., inspections, audits, incident management, maintenance cycles)
  • Ensure processes are practical, audit-ready, and consistently adopted across locations

    • KPI & Performance Management

  • Define and implement KPIs across key areas (fleet utilization, safety performance, compliance adherence, maintenance reliability)
  • Build dashboards and reporting frameworks to track performance at site, regional, and company levels
  • Establish performance cadences (weekly/monthly) to drive accountability and continuous improvement

    • Cross-Functional Program Leadership

  • Own and drive high-impact initiatives across Operations, Fleet, Safety, Finance, and Product
  • Align stakeholders, clarify ownership, and improve cross-functional workflows
  • Act as the central connector to unblock issues and ensure progress

    • Execution & Continuous Improvement

  • Drive disciplined execution with clear milestones, timelines, and measurable outcomes
  • Identify risks—especially in safety and compliance—and implement mitigation plans
  • Conduct post-implementation reviews and continuously refine processes

    • Change Management & Adoption

  • Lead rollout and adoption of new processes, tools, and KPI frameworks
  • Influence stakeholders from frontline operators to senior leadership
  • Ensure solutions are embedded into daily operations and sustained over time

• 5–10+ years of experience in operations, program management, or process improvement in a fast-paced environment
  • Background in consulting, strategic finance, logistics, manufacturing, or related operational environments
  • Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through execution
  • Strong communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into insights and actionable decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to improve efficiency, safety, compliance, and cost performance
  • High ownership with the ability to operate independently and manage competing priorities
  • Experience building KPI frameworks, dashboards, and performance management cadences
  • Advanced Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs); SQL preferred
  • Experience in transportation, fleet operations, safety, compliance, or tech-enabled operations is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or relevant advanced degree is a plus
    •  
    The targeted base salary range for this role is listed in the compensation section below. Actual salary may be above or below this range based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. In addition, this position may include additional compensation in the form of equity or commissions. If you are a full-time salaried or hourly worker, we offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Holidays, Wellness, Vacation, and more. The targeted pay range for this role in US CA is: $155,000 to $185,000

This role is based at the Company’s headquarters in Redwood Shores, CA and requires you to be onsite 3x/week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). We will only consider candidates already based in the Bay Area.
Who You Are:  We're hiring our first HQ-based front end engineer who will lead front end technical direction for Zūm while staying hands-on as an individual contributor. This role operates as a technical lead; you'll set technical direction, make front end architecture decisions, and lead a team of engineers in Ukraine, while still writing code and shipping features yourself.
You'll own the front end behind our dispatch, school, vendor, and maps portals — enterprise, data-dense tools that districts, transportation vendors, and internal operations teams rely on to run complex logistics.
You'll work from HQ, in close collaboration with our local Product and Engineering teams. The Ukraine Front End team's hours overlap with HQ until roughly 11am PT, so this role doesn't require working offshore hours.
What You'll Do:
Own front end technical decisions and architecture across our Angular codebase, including patterns for state management and reactive UI (RxJS)
Lead the Ukraine-based front end team technically: set direction, unblock hard problems, and raise the bar on craft, while still writing production code
Work within an existing structure where PMs and backend teams drive most product and design direction, and Front End owns execution and technical quality
Partner closely with PMs (who work in Figma with design) and backend engineering to turn direction into shipped, reliable front end systems
Push the team's use of AI tooling forward, spotting where we're moving too slowly and driving the automation that changes that
Bring technical leadership to infrastructure-level front end work, not only user-facing feature delivery
Absorb the tech lead function currently split across two people and consolidate front end technical decision-making under one clear owner
Set architectural standards for how our Angular apps handle state, data density, and reactive patterns across dispatch, school, vendor, and maps portals
Identify where AI tooling could meaningfully speed up front end development and build the case (and the tooling) to get there
Mentor and technically lead engineers on the Ukraine-based team, working within overlapping HQ hours rather than offshore shifts
Build trust with PMs and backend leads so that front end execution stays fast and clean even as product direction comes from elsewhere
What You Bring To Zūm:
Senior+ or Staff-level front end engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership, not just individual contribution
Strong, hands-on experience with Angular; you should be able to step into our stack and start contributing quickly
Experience with reactive UI patterns and RxJS or equivalent observables-based architecture
Comfort building and owning enterprise, data-dense web applications, not consumer products or analytics dashboards
Experience technically leading or mentoring other engineers, ideally across a distributed team
Genuine interest in AI-driven automation, with real opinions on where a team could move faster
Experience stepping into or consolidating a tech lead function previously shared across multiple people (preferred)
Startup background (preferred; a plus, though not a strict requirement)
Experience with mobile web, not native mobile, not React Native (preferred)
Bonus Points:
Domain experience in mobility, logistics, fleet, or other operationally complex enterprise software
Experience with mapping or GPS-adjacent UI, relevant to our maps portal surface
Experience collaborating closely with design in Figma-based workflows
The targeted base salary range for this role is listed in the compensation section below. Actual salary may be above or below this range based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. In addition, this position may include additional compensation in the form of equity or commissions. If you are a full-time salaried or hourly worker, we offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Holidays, Wellness, Vacation, and more. The targeted pay range for this role in CA, USA is: $240,000 - $280,000 plus stock options.

This role is based at the Company’s headquarters in Redwood Shores, CA and requires you to be onsite 3x/week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday). We will only consider candidates already based in the Bay Area.

Who You Are:
You care as much about how software gets built as what it does, and you measure a platform by the features it enables.
You want to build scalable infrastructure and technologies that enable Zūm products to grow and adapt at the pace today's AI makes possible.
You lead through execution and influence through adoption of the platforms you build.
When someone asks for "the best" solution, you map out the tradeoffs, present real options, and commit to a recommendation.
You start simple, add complexity only when the data proves you need it, and lean on experience when measuring isn't worth the cost.
Products created on your platform are easy to maintain and a joy to build on.
What You'll Do:
Own the architecture and roadmap for Zūm's product platform, and build it - our product engineering team uses TypeScript/Node.js, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Redis, Kafka, and gRPC.
Stay hands-on with the product: build and review features, so foundational layers stay grounded in how they're actually used.
Work with product teams to decide what stays in the monolith and what becomes its own service, and make that extraction process routine and low-risk when it happens.
Make security and compliance part of the platform by design: build shared primitives for authentication and access rules to sensitive data, so product teams build on secure, policy-aligned foundations.
Watch how the platform behaves under real production load and evolve it ahead of need: spot emerging bottlenecks (event-loop stalls, slow queries, locking, index design, partition skew, consumer lag, RPC latency, retry storms, etc.), trace them to the architectural cause, and turn recurring problems into platform improvements.
Build the rules, automated checks, and tooling improvements that steer AI coding agents toward writing code that already fits platform patterns and conventions.
Jump in on live platform issues, lead incident and correction-of-error reviews, and own the systemic fixes that follow.
Act as the escalation point and thought partner for engineering leadership on platform investment and tradeoffs.
What You Bring To Zūm:
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
8+ years of industry experience as a Software Engineer, with significant time spent building platforms, shared services, or core backend systems that other engineering teams build on.
Deep expertise in Node.js/TypeScript (or a comparable backend language) and strong command of relational database design, including schema modeling, indexing, and query performance.
Hands-on experience with the building blocks of a modern service-oriented backend: Kubernetes, Kafka or equivalent messaging systems, gRPC or similar RPC frameworks, Redis, and search/indexing systems like OpenSearch.
Experience designing and building authentication/authorization systems, including SSO protocols (SAML, OIDC) and authorization models (RBAC/ABAC).
Track record of extracting services from a monolith deliberately and safely, with clear judgment about what should and shouldn't be split out.
Comfort diagnosing performance issues at the architectural level: query plans, locking, partitioning, consumer lag, RPC latency, and similar failure modes.
Proven ability to set technical direction and drive adoption through good defaults, not mandate.
Excellent communication skills, comfortable holding a technical line respectfully in design reviews.
Comfort operating with a high degree of ownership and autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment.
Good sense of humor with a great ability to work with others.
Bonus Points:
Passionate about working for a mission-driven company.
Experience embedding engineering standards into AI coding agents or developer tooling (linting/agent rules, code generation harnesses, automated review checks).
Experience building platforms in a regulated or compliance-sensitive space (e.g., education, healthcare, fintech) where access control and data handling are first-class concerns.
Experience working in transportation, logistics, or another operationally complex industry.

  • Own the architecture and roadmap for Zūm's product platform, and build it - our product engineering team uses TypeScript/Node.js, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Redis, Kafka, and gRPC.
  • Stay hands-on with the product: build and review features, so foundational layers stay grounded in how they're actually used.
  • Work with product teams to decide what stays in the monolith and what becomes its own service, and make that extraction process routine and low-risk when it happens.
  • Make security and compliance part of the platform by design: build shared primitives for authentication and access rules to sensitive data, so product teams build on secure, policy-aligned foundations.
  • Watch how the platform behaves under real production load and evolve it ahead of need: spot emerging bottlenecks (event-loop stalls, slow queries, locking, index design, partition skew, consumer lag, RPC latency, retry storms, etc.), trace them to the architectural cause, and turn recurring problems into platform improvements.
  • Build the rules, automated checks, and tooling improvements that steer AI coding agents toward writing code that already fits platform patterns and conventions.
  • Jump in on live platform issues, lead incident and correction-of-error reviews, and own the systemic fixes that follow.
  • Act as the escalation point and thought partner for engineering leadership on platform investment and tradeoffs.

What You Bring To Zūm:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of industry experience as a Software Engineer, with significant time spent building platforms, shared services, or core backend systems that other engineering teams build on.
  • Deep expertise in Node.js/TypeScript (or a comparable backend language) and strong command of relational database design, including schema modeling, indexing, and query performance.
  • Hands-on experience with the building blocks of a modern service-oriented backend: Kubernetes, Kafka or equivalent messaging systems, gRPC or similar RPC frameworks, Redis, and search/indexing systems like OpenSearch.
  • Experience designing and building authentication/authorization systems, including SSO protocols (SAML, OIDC) and authorization models (RBAC/ABAC).
  • Track record of extracting services from a monolith deliberately and safely, with clear judgment about what should and shouldn't be split out.
  • Comfort diagnosing performance issues at the architectural level: query plans, locking, partitioning, consumer lag, RPC latency, and similar failure modes.
  • Proven ability to set technical direction and drive adoption through good defaults, not mandate.
  • Excellent communication skills, comfortable holding a technical line respectfully in design reviews.
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of ownership and autonomy in a fast-moving startup environment.
  • Good sense of humor with a great ability to work with others.

Bonus Points:

  • Passionate about working for a mission-driven company.
  • Experience embedding engineering standards into AI coding agents or developer tooling (linting/agent rules, code generation harnesses, automated review checks).
  • Experience building platforms in a regulated or compliance-sensitive space (e.g., education, healthcare, fintech) where access control and data handling are first-class concerns.
  • Experience working in transportation, logistics, or another operationally complex industry.

About Zūm:
Zūm is revolutionizing mass mobility with its Connected Mobility Experience (Zūm CMX™) system that connects and coordinates people, vehicles, and operations in real time. In the $50 billion student mobility market – the largest segment of the mass mobility industry – Zūm CMX  is transforming a daily source of anxiety and disruption into a reliable, transparent, and efficient mobility experience for students and families. Today, more than 7,500 schools rely on Zūm CMX. Recognized globally for its innovative approach and operational execution, Zūm has been named to Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50 and Changemakers, the World Economic Forum, and the Financial Times’ Fastest Growing Companies lists. Zūm is backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, GIC, TPG, and Softbank.


About the Role:
As a Strategic Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle for Zūm's SaaS offerings, providing self-operated districts AI-driven routing, real-time vehicle and student visibility, and tools that improve on-time performance and communication with parents and students. You will build trusted relationships with transportation directors, superintendents, and district technology teams, guiding them through complex, multi-stakeholder, public-sector buying processes. This role reports to our Vice President of SaaS Sales.

lists.content:
• Own your territory from first conversation to signed contract, and build account plans that map each key district's decision-makers, influencers, budget calendar and procurement path

  • Effectively prospect, develop, and close new districts, consistently meeting or exceeding quarterly and annual quota

  • Run discovery and tailored demos of Zūm CMX that connect real-time visibility, AI-driven routing, and fleet efficiency to each district's goals for on-time performance, attendance, trust from parents and students, and cost savings

  • Maintain a healthy, well-documented pipeline, and accurate forecast in our CRM

  • Use in-depth knowledge of industry trends to consult and support prospective customers, and share customer and competitive insights across Sales, Marketing, Product, and Legal teams

  • Respond to and shape RFPs, RFQs, and proposals, partnering with Product, Solutions, Legal, and Finance to craft pricing and contract structures that win

  • Represent Zūm at national and  state education and transportation conferences, building a strong reference network in your territory

• 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally as a strategic or enterprise Account Executive, with a track record of closing six-figure and multi-year deals and consistently meeting quota

  • Direct experience selling technology or services to K-12 school districts or other public-sector buyers, including familiarity with RFPs, cooperative purchasing, and board approvals; school transportation experience a plus

  • Proven ability to run complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, from superintendents and CFOs to operations and IT leaders

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, particularly in consultative selling, presentation, and negotiation, and strong analytical and creative problem solving abilities

  • Ability to hold your own in meetings with  both senior officials  and day-to-day operators and speak as a thought leader in the transportation space

  • Entrepreneurial self-starter who is comfortable with travel within the territory, motivated by the mission of improving students' daily journey to school, and excited to work in a fast-growing, quickly changing environment

About the Role
We're seeking an experienced Technician I to serve as a cornerstone of our maintenance operations. This role encompasses comprehensive vehicle diagnostics, repairs, and preventive maintenance across our fleet. You'll diagnose complex mechanical and electrical issues, perform critical safety inspections, and ensure every vehicle meets rigorous DOT and safety standards. You'll be essential to our transportation operations, keeping our fleet safe, reliable, and ready to serve students and communities.
What Makes You Successful in This Role
You're a skilled diagnostician who thrives in a fast-paced maintenance environment where no two days are the same. You balance speed with precision, never compromising on safety or quality standards. You're a natural problem-solver who can trace issues from symptoms to root causes across complex vehicle systems. You take ownership of your work and pride yourself on first-time fixes. You're equally comfortable rebuilding an engine, troubleshooting intricate electrical systems, or conducting thorough preventive maintenance inspections. You maintain an organized workspace where tools are properly stored, documentation is complete, and every repair meets professional standards.

lists.content:
Vehicle Diagnostics & Repair

  • Diagnose malfunctions and perform vehicle repairs including steering, electrical, cooling, lubricating, braking systems, drivetrains, suspensions, steering systems, clutches, transmissions, and oil, temperature, gas regulating components
  • Adjust, test, and rebuild engines and related assigned duties within qualification level, in accordance with all relevant Federal, State/Provincial and local guidelines and requirements
  • Perform test drives during Preventative Maintenance inspections to identify driver reported issues and conduct test drives after service to confirm repairs have been completed successfully
  • Install, program, replace and verify telematic devices

    • Maintenance Operations

  • Perform the work needed to implement preventive maintenance for the vehicles serviced by this maintenance facility
  • Perform the work needed to complete unscheduled repairs to the vehicles serviced by this maintenance facility
  • Perform road calls and on-the-road repairs as assigned
  • Record time spent, parts used and repairs and/or maintenance conducted on the work tablet and/or authorized form

    • Safety & Compliance

  • Maintain a safe, clean, productive, and efficient work area including ensuring the work area is in compliance with all relevant Federal, State/Provincial, local guidelines and requirements, and company Housekeeping standards and safety regulations
  • Perform work within scope of duties and in accordance with DOT compliance requirements
  • Work assigned shift and overtime as needed

Basic Qualifications:

  • 1-3 years of fleet experience in Diesel, Heavy/Med duty fleets
  • Minimum of five years Auto/Truck or Bus mechanical repair experience
  • Experience with compliance with the local applicable DOT compliance of Med/Heavy Trucks
  • Computer proficiency for fleet management systems and documentation
  • Possess the recommended minimum hand tools for a Medium and Heavy Duty and Diesel Technician
  • Strong experience with computerized diagnostics
  • Ability to use good judgment and decision-making skills
  • Background in planning and scheduling maintenance repairs (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)
  • Willingness to work flexible schedules

    • Preferred Qualifications:

  • Valid CDL License (Must be able to obtain within the first 90 days of employment)
  • ASE Certification in brakes, suspension, engine, electrical, A/C or a Master School Bus and/or a Master Truck Technician

The targeted base salary range for this role is listed in the compensation section below. Actual salary may be above or below this range based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. In addition, this position may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity, or commissions. If you are a full-time salaried or hourly worker, we offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Holidays, Wellness, Vacation, and more. The targeted pay for this role in $40.82/hour.

descriptionBody:
About the Role

We're seeking an experienced Technician I to serve as a cornerstone of our maintenance operations. This role encompasses comprehensive vehicle diagnostics, repairs, and preventive maintenance across our fleet. You'll diagnose complex mechanical and electrical issues, perform critical safety inspections, and ensure every vehicle meets rigorous DOT and safety standards. You'll be essential to our transportation operations, keeping our fleet safe, reliable, and ready to serve students and communities.

What Makes You Successful in This Role

You're a skilled diagnostician who thrives in a fast-paced maintenance environment where no two days are the same. You balance speed with precision, never compromising on safety or quality standards. You're a natural problem-solver who can trace issues from symptoms to root causes across complex vehicle systems. You take ownership of your work and pride yourself on first-time fixes. You're equally comfortable rebuilding an engine, troubleshooting intricate electrical systems, or conducting thorough preventive maintenance inspections. You maintain an organized workspace where tools are properly stored, documentation is complete, and every repair meets professional standards.

Vehicle Diagnostics & Repair

  • Diagnose malfunctions and perform vehicle repairs including steering, electrical, cooling, lubricating, braking systems, drivetrains, suspensions, steering systems, clutches, transmissions, and oil, temperature, gas regulating components
  • Adjust, test, and rebuild engines and related assigned duties within qualification level, in accordance with all relevant Federal, State/Provincial and local guidelines and requirements
  • Perform test drives during Preventative Maintenance inspections to identify driver reported issues and conduct test drives after service to confirm repairs have been completed successfully
  • Install, program, replace and verify telematic devices

    • Maintenance Operations

  • Perform the work needed to implement preventive maintenance for the vehicles serviced by this maintenance facility
  • Perform the work needed to complete unscheduled repairs to the vehicles serviced by this maintenance facility
  • Perform road calls and on-the-road repairs as assigned
  • Record time spent, parts used and repairs and/or maintenance conducted on the work tablet and/or authorized form

    • Safety & Compliance

  • Maintain a safe, clean, productive, and efficient work area including ensuring the work area is in compliance with all relevant Federal, State/Provincial, local guidelines and requirements, and company Housekeeping standards and safety regulations
  • Perform work within scope of duties and in accordance with DOT compliance requirements
  • Work assigned shift and overtime as needed

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2-4 years of fleet experience in Diesel, Heavy/Med duty fleets
  • Minimum of five years Auto/Truck or Bus mechanical repair experience
  • Experience with compliance with the local applicable DOT compliance of Med/Heavy Trucks
  • Computer proficiency for fleet management systems and documentation
  • Possess the recommended minimum hand tools for a Medium and Heavy Duty and Diesel Technician
  • Strong experience with computerized diagnostics
  • Ability to use good judgment and decision-making skills
  • Background in planning and scheduling maintenance repairs (Daily, Weekly, Monthly)

  • Valid CDL License (Must be able to obtain within the first 90 days of employment)
  • ASE Certification in brakes, suspension, engine, electrical, A/C or a Master School Bus and/or a Master Truck Technician

The targeted base salary range for this role is listed in the compensation section below. Actual salary may be above or below this range based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. In addition, this position may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity, or commissions. If you are a full-time salaried or hourly worker, we offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), Holidays, Wellness, Vacation, and more. The targeted pay for this role in $37 - $41/hour.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Zum provides safe, reliable, technology-enabled student transportation for school districts. We are growing quickly: new districts, new yards, and new markets launch while existing ones are still being built out. The VP of Operations runs a multi-market in the east region P&L, leads general managers and their teams, and owns the operating rhythm that keeps buses running safely and on time. This is a hands-on, start-up-mode role for someone who can build, manage the process, and still step into a yard and roll up their sleeves when needed.
OPERATING RHYTHM
Daily: Route coverage, dispatch, on-time performance, driver safety messages, same-day escalations
Weekly: KPI release and action plans, labor review, customer launch calls, payroll dashboard review, AR collections
Monthly: Safety themes, union dues and benefits compliance, forecast-to-actual review, liquidated damages reconciliation
Seasonal: Back-to-school readiness, budget planning, renewals, 45-day scaling forecast
As needed: Involvement in bargaining, grievances, discipline, incident investigations, service-disruption planning
START-UP MODE
Launch new districts and yards  while running existing ones, moving people and fleet across markets as needed
Write and standardize SOPs, RACIs, and protocols where none exist
Be decisive, often with incomplete information 
Step in directly when a manager leaves or a launch stalls
NEW CONTRACT IMPLEMENTATION
Own the handoff from Sales through Day One and stabilization:
Handoff: Review contracts, pricing, and commitments with Sales, Legal, and Finance
Plan: Name an owner and build backward from first day of service
Staffing and training: Size teams including spares; lead recruiting, CDL training, and background checks
Labor and compliance: Determine CBA coverage and set up payroll and benefits
Customer readiness: Launch meetings, dry runs, and written scope changes
Stabilize: Provide go-live support, move to steady-state KPIs, and hold a post-launch review
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Regional operations: Own on-time performance, coverage, and service quality
Financials: Own the regional P&L, budget, forecast accuracy, and expense control
Renewals and collections: Lead renewals and AR, including disputed invoices and liquidated damages
Escalations: Be the escalation point for district and union contract disputes, working with Legal and HR
HQ liaison: Connect field operations with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, HR, Legal, Safety, and Technology
People leadership: Lead and coach GMs and field managers, handle performance issues, and run promotion panels
Safety and compliance: Lead incident reviews, make documented discipline decisions, and oversee training and records
Labor relations: Support bargaining, grievances, arbitration, and CBA implementation
Customer relationships: Serve as senior operational contact for district leaders
Driver pipeline: Oversee hiring, spare ratios, CDL training, retention, and recognition
Fleet and technology: Evaluate routing vendors and support yard and equipment readiness
REQUIREMENTS
10+ years in operations, including 5+ leading multi-site or multi-region teams in student transportation, logistics, or similar safety-critical field operations
Experience in high-growth or turnaround settings, launching sites and building process from scratch
Strong financial skills: budgeting, forecasting, expense control, and AR management
Direct union experience (CBA administration, grievances, discipline, bargaining) and skill in renewals and escalations with districts and unions
Command of DOT/FMCSA, CDL, and state pupil-transportation requirements
Public-sector contract experience, including SLAs and liquidated damages
Fluency with operational and workforce data, turned into weekly action
Strong multitasking and proactive planning; exceptional written and verbal communication
Willingness to travel
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
